acceptance_criteria: X-BPM-Signature header present in dispatched webhook for secret-configured subscription
description: TC-EXT-02-INT-05 (Signature header is present only for secret-configured subscription and matches body HMAC) fails: signed_receiver.signature_seen is false after calling dispatchDueWebhookAttempts. The HMAC X-BPM-Signature header is not being added to the webhook dispatch HTTP request for secret-configured subscriptions. This is a functional defect in the dispatcher signature logic, not related to the ISS-0118 status value assertion fix.
title: TC-EXT-02-INT-05: HMAC webhook signature header not seen during dispatch
resolution: DUPLICATE of ISS-0636/GH-618 (PR #624, merged 2026-08-09). Same test (TC-EXT-02-INT-05), same symptom (signed_receiver.signature_seen == false), same discovery run (WF03-GH381-20260809) as ISS-0633/GH-614 and ISS-0634/GH-615/GH-619 -- three issues independently filed from the same TEST-RUNNER step before any of the fixes landed. The actual root cause was in subscription_store.createSubscription (it ignored req.secret entirely, never populating secret_ref), not in dispatcher.zig's signature logic as this issue's 'probable root cause' speculated -- the dispatcher's HMAC signing was already correct once secret_ref was actually populated. No separate fix needed here. Verified on current main: zig build test-integration-ext02 -- 10/10 tests pass, including TC-EXT-02-INT-05.
